name: Marketing

subjectOf.text: ICO promoters should not allow tokens to be traded before the underlying protocol network or application is live, and should not use a landing page that focuses almost exclusively on the ICO while providing less content on the product, project, technology, and team.
subjectOf.abstract: Such practices include allowing tokens to be traded before underlying protocol network or application is live, using a landing page that focuses almost exclusively on the ICO with project timeline etc. but provides less content on product, project, technology, and team.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Marco Dell'Erba, Initial Coin Offerings Emerging Practices, Risk Factors, and Red Flags (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3067615
scope_conditions: emerging bad ICO practices identified in 2017

subjectOf.text: Easier access to trading data and to information about the hedge fund industry has been a significant factor in the growth of hedge fund assets, because analytic platforms let managers manipulate peer and style data and build targeted marketing materials.
subjectOf.abstract: Easier access to trading data and information about the hedge fund industry has been a significant factor in the growth of hedge fund assets.
subjectOf.citation: Kaal, Financial Technology and Hedge Funds (2019). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=3409548
scope_conditions: commercial hedge fund databases and analytic platforms available

subjectOf.text: Without significant marketing a fair launch token is less likely to reach a diverse set of market participants, and projects reaching only a few hundred investors with small million dollar market caps are much more prone to abuse and manipulation.
subjectOf.abstract: Without significant marketing of the project, it is less likely the token will reach a diverse set of market participants. Projects that only reach a few hundred investors and only small million-dollar market caps are much more prone to abuse and manipulation.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Fair Token Launch (2022). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4015908
scope_conditions: token launches with limited marketing reach

subjectOf.text: Equal opportunity access points for public marketing incentives cannot be guaranteed and require constant reevaluation, so the public marketing permission for any fair token launch should be restricted to a limited percentage of total token supply.
subjectOf.abstract: These equal opportunity access points cannot be guaranteed and the process is subject to constant reevaluation. The public marketing permission for any fair token launch should be restricted to a limited percentage of total token supply.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Fair Token Launch (2022). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4015908
scope_conditions: fair launch project grants public marketing incentives
